snippet.title: The Perfect Game to Play While Watching Videos! | Goblin Attack Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Ready for an addictive idle/clicker experience that sits perfectly on the side of your screen while you do other things? Goblin Attack is out now on Steam!

Build your goblin army, upgrade your base, gather loot, and watch your forces grow stronger while you work, watch videos, or play other games in the background. With its seamless overlay/desktop design, it's the ultimate secondary screen companion!

Wishlist / Buy on Steam now: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4502210/Goblin_Attack/

If you want to support an indie developer, please subscribe for future updates, leave a comment, and drop a like! Thank you for watching!
